entities.summary: Rosa Genoni (1867–1954) was an Italian seamstress, fashion designer, teacher, feminist and advocate for workers' rights. She had a successful fashion design career, with innovative designs such as her Tanagra dress. In 1915, Genoni was the Italian delegate at the International Congress of Women, The Hague, Netherlands. Her activism efforts along with her desire to make Italy a fashion leader were thwarted under Fascism.
